confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Koh Lanta and Thai island pricing, not live listings. Restaurant anchors are the most reliable; cocktail and wine are weaker and follow the local beer relationship. Hostel and hotel prices are the most uncertain, and July is low season on the Andaman coast, so they are set toward the lower end. FX caveat: the 0.6955 rate appears in an RBA homepage search snippet (as at 4.00 pm, 15 October 2026) that I did not open directly, and a second search could not reproduce it. Third-party figures of about 0.69 to 0.70 are consistent with it, but it is unverified against the RBA table.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on smaller beach towns and islands on Thailand's Andaman coast (Krabi province and the Phuket-area resort towns outside Patong), adjusted down for Koh Lanta's quieter, less commercial profile and July green-season discounting.
